title: Issue approvals, idempotent creation, and dependency links
objective: Present Issue drafts by Parent, retain approval state, require explicit approval for each remote write, create Issues idempotently, and preserve hard blockers.
input: N09 validated plan and fresh remote reads
acceptance_criteria: Group and individual approve/edit/reject/exclude are persisted; unapproved drafts remain local.
Only explicitly approved drafts create remote Issues.
Stable plan/task markers plus fresh remote checks prevent duplicate creation on retries/interruption.
Hard blockers use native GitHub dependencies; approved downstream work remains blocked if prerequisite is excluded/unapproved.
undo_classification: Do not auto-delete created Issues; reconcile via stable markers and preserve audit evidence.
approval_requirements: Explicit user approval for each GitHub Issue creation and remote dependency mutation.
retry_policy: Initial attempt plus at most 2 retries; on ambiguous remote result, query and reconcile before retry.
blocking_reasons: N04, N09 and approved Issue required.
